profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It operates a cloud storage and file-sharing platform that, per its own site, offers secure storage, file collaboration, and a content organization product called Dash, which the company describes as a way to save time and organize all company content in one place. The site also notes that Dropbox supports previews for 175+ file types and synced team folders.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which the site describes as providing document summaries, team data access, and sharing controls. The company describes integrations with leading AI platforms that allow users to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries noted as coming soon.

Dropbox is a publicly traded company on the ticker DBX, with a CIK of 0001467623. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from a 10-K filing for the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000. The held facts also record one MCP server associated with Dropbox, a third-party entry named ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, described as enabling users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files, find documents by name or content, and list folders.
